abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.
